protocol.folds: 3 approved walk-forward folds only; 2025/26 never loaded or evaluated
protocol.basis: mean validation log loss across folds 1-3
protocol.purpose: robustness check of the Phase 4A A->B result; NOT model selection

q10_edge_of_grid_flags.note: A best-C at the grid edge suggests the optimum may lie outside the frozen grid (over- or under-regularization); this is reported, not acted upon.

robustness_analysis.interpretation_guard: Robustness is descriptive only. No statistical test was performed, so no significance claim may be made. No causal claim. This does not select a production model and does not authorize changing V1.
